# Plants Care Database

> Comprehensive houseplant care system (PWA v3.0). 26 plants with detailed care protocols, water chemistry, soil recipes, feeding schedules, and diagnostics.

## Pages

- [Plant Catalog](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/plants-catalog.html): Full catalog of 26 plants with care cards — lighting (lux), watering, humidity, soil mix, feeding schedule, wick watering compatibility, water group (PPM/pH), difficulty level, fun facts and common problems.
- [Water Groups](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/water-groups.html): Plants organized by water chemistry requirements. Group A (PPM 60-90, pH 5.8-6.3) — sensitive plants. Group B (PPM 90-140, pH 6.0-6.5) — aroids. Group C (PPM 120-170, pH 6.2-6.7) — hardy plants. All use RO water + CalMag.
- [Lighting Groups](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/lighting-groups.html): Plants organized by light needs — Low (2000-5000 lux), Medium (5000-9000 lux), Bright (9000-10000+ lux).
- [Soil Mixes](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/soil-groups.html): 12 soil mix recipes with percentage and parts-based ratios. Mixes for aroids, prayer plants, palms, bromeliads, begonias, orchids, ferns, succulents, carnivorous plants, velvet anthuriums.
- [Feeding Guide](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/feeding-guide.html): Fertilizer schedules by season (growth/dormancy) and plant group (aroids, sensitive, general, flowering, carnivorous).
- [Water Mixer](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/water-mixer.html): RO water mixing calculator — 3 canister recipes (A/B/C) with PPM, pH targets, CalMag and fertilizer dosing.
- [Watering Tracker](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/watering-tracker.html): Watering and flushing log tracker per canister group.
- [Plant Problems](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/plant-problems.html): Diagnostics for 26 plants with 60+ symptom-solution pairs.
- [Propagation](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/propagation.html): Propagation methods (water, soil, division, air layering, offsets) for 15+ plants with difficulty ratings.
- [Seasonal Care](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/seasonal-care.html): Season-specific care tips for all plants.
- [Pests & Diseases](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/pests-diseases.html): Pest identification and treatment guide.
- [My Products](https://yurakatz.github.io/Plants/my-products.html): 8 fertilizers and additives in 3 categories with dosing instructions.

## Data

- Primary data source: `plants.yaml` — structured YAML with full care specs per plant.
- Soil recipes: `soil-mixes.yaml` — 12 mixes with component percentages.
- Water chemistry: `water-requirements.yaml` — PPM/pH targets per group.
- Fertilizers: `fertilizers.yaml` — product details and dosing.
- Troubleshooting: `troubleshooting.yaml` — symptom-solution database.

## Plant Collection (26 plants)

Aroids: Monstera deliciosa, Monstera adansonii, Philodendron Imperial Green, Philodendron bipinnatifidum (selloum), Epipremnum aureum, Spathiphyllum, Aglaonema, Alocasia amazonica, Alocasia Frydek, Anthurium andraeanum, Anthurium clarinervium.
Prayer plants: Calathea lancifolia, Calathea ornata.
Palms: Dracaena marginata, Dracaena fragrans, Chamaedorea.
Other: Guzmania, Begonia maculata, Phalaenopsis, Saintpaulia, Codiaeum (Croton), Nephrolepis, Sansevieria, Zamioculcas, Schlumbergera, Dionaea muscipula, Actinidia (Kiwi).

## Key Features

- RO water system with CalMag remineralization
- 3 water groups by PPM/pH sensitivity
- 12 soil mix recipes (percentage + parts ratios)
- Wick watering compatibility tracking
- Season-aware feeding (growth vs dormancy)
- Lux-based lighting groups
- PWA with offline support
